name: Speechless vowel loop
desc: A wordless vocal loop chopped and morphed through a slowly cycling vowel formant filter, opposite-phase lpf and pan sweeps, chunk reversals at peak. Hypnotic driving techno vocal texture.

code.full: s("speechless").loopAt(2).chop(16).vowel("<a e i o u a i e>").speed(${spd}).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.5).slow(16)).shape(.4).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.7, ${gain}).fast(4)).pan(cosine.range(.35,.65).slow(16)).every(4, x=>x.speed(1.5)).room(.4).delay(${send}).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.45).orbit(8).play()
code.peak: s("speechless").loopAt(1).chop(16).vowel("<a e i o u a e i>*2").speed("<1 1.25 .8>").lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.9, ${cut}*1.9).slow(8)).shape(.4).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.7, ${gain}).fast(4)).pan(cosine.range(.3,.7).slow(8)).chunk(4, x=>x.rev()).jux(rev).room(.4).delay(${send}).delaytime(.1875).delayfeedback(.5).orbit(8).play()
